newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 13.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Local securities authorities have taken measures to control risk on the financial markets in response to Beijing's call to make 1997 a year of risk control.

- China's financial situation was good in the first quarter of 1997 with the growth of broad money supply falling by 4.2 percentage points compared with last year, indicating inflationary pressure was further relieved.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai and Beijing have banned any new beeper exchange stations given the excessive number already in operation.
- Shanghai has set up a new urban district named Jinshan District, which will be a major base for the city's chemical industry.
